phase_name: Acceptance measurement -- 10 consecutive runs under concurrent load

objectives.description: Record HEAD and git status before measurement block
Diff source-store touched files against deployed .claude/ counterparts
Run run-all.sh --quiet ten consecutive times, capture summary + FAIL lines
Ensure concurrent session active during block, demonstrate contention
objectives.note: Concurrent session activity demonstrated (timestamped events for a distinct task-85 session within the window); lock/shared-state contention not demonstrable because run-all.sh touches no locks (plan Finding 3)

objectives.description: Compare ten results for identical pass condition, including suite composition
Record full measurement in implementation summary

deviations.description: Ensure at least one concurrent session is active during the block; note which runs overlapped concurrent activity
deviations.reason: Concurrent session activity was demonstrated with timestamped evidence (a distinct session for this same task recorded events inside the 21-minute measurement window), but genuine lock/shared-state contention could not be demonstrated because run-all.sh acquires no locks and touches no shared state (task-lock.sh, specs/.locks, specs/state.json) per this plan's own Finding 3 -- that stricter bar is structurally unattainable for this specific script. The literal plan-text criterion ('at least one other session active') is met; a stricter 'contending for shared state' reading is not, and cannot be, for this measurement.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- see summary for full evidence)*
